messages:
Meera: Quick postmortem follow-up for the cust-acme isolation incident (VPC peering + on-prem agent). I pulled the action items from the root postmortem and assigned owners. Short list, concrete next steps:

1) Fix VPC peering race that causes transient isolation when the onprem agent restarts. Owner: Amit. ETA: 2026-04-20 (2 weeks). Brief plan: add connect backoff + idempotent peer attach. Config to tweak: `peer.connect_timeout_ms` -> 15000.

2) Investigate on-prem agent memory growth under heavy KV load (repro with cust-acme dataset). Owner: Sam K. ETA: 2026-04-13 (1 week). Needs reproducer + heap dump.

3) Build an isolation test harness that simulates flaky peering and agent restarts (adds CI job). Owner: Jordan. ETA: 2026-04-09 (4 days). Will wire to `eng-runtime` CI with `--sim-peering-drop`.

4) Runbook & postmortem doc edits (clear incident owner escalation steps + checklist). Owner: Elaine R. ETA: 2026-04-07 (3 days). Include rollback steps for Dedicated.

5) Detection: create recurring anomaly alert for ephemeral peering resets (monthly pattern check). Owner: Meera. ETA: next sprint start (2026-04-05).

Blockers: security review required for the KMS peering test account (assigned to security team). Also, on-prem constraints: cust-acme cannot accept kernel module changes, so we must avoid agent changes that require sudo.

Please confirm ownership or reassign. I will add these to the incident tracker and label them P1/P2 accordingly. :memo:

Jordan: Happy to own the test harness. Quick Q: do we prefer an integration test that runs in our staging VPC or a full onprem emulator? I can start with a staging-level test and then extend to emulator.

Meera: Staging-first is fine. Need the emulator only if staging can't reproduce. Prioritize fast feedback.

Sam K.: I have a partial reproducer. Posting the sanitized logs below; can someone confirm the request pattern that triggered the heavy KV churn?

Sam K.: ```
2026-03-29T22:11:02Z agent|INFO KV op apply start id=a1b2
2026-03-29T22:11:03Z agent|WARN mem.used 1.9GB delta +120MB
2026-03-29T22:11:04Z agent|ERROR reconnect peer=peer-33 err=io timeout
```

Amit: I'll take the peering code change. Plan to open a PR with the backoff + idempotent attach by 2026-04-06. Will mark as draft today.

Elaine R.: For runbook edits, can someone share the minimal rollback commands for Dedicated? I want to include a clear snippet.

Meera: Add this to runbook: `redwoodctl model-route set --fallback=small-quant --confirm` and `redwoodctl capacity scale --target=0.5 --confirm` (include safety flags). I'll paste a diff in the doc.

incidents-bot: Reminder — please add each action item to the postmortem tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/track/ACME-2026-03 (use tags: cust-acme, onprem, vpc).

Jordan: I will spin up the staging test this afternoon and post results here. If staging reproduces, I will create a small CI job and link the PR.

Sam K.: I'll attach heap dump when I get confirmation on repro steps. If anyone on infra can reserve a staging node for heavy KV tests, ping me.

Amit: Draft PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/peering/pull/312 (title: "peering: idempotent attach + backoff"). Will request review from eng-runtime.

Elaine R.: Runbook diff uploaded to the postmortem doc. 👍

Meera: Thanks everyone — let's treat the VPC peering fix as highest priority. I'll follow up in two days with a consolidated ETA update. If anything slips, call it out here so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
